nodes.rationale: Board self-heating skews readings; temperature offset setting calibrates it.

nodes.label: App state machine (IDLE/RECORDING/PLAYING/SLEEPING)
nodes.rationale: isRecording derived from state; one codec means no play while recording and vice versa.

nodes.label: Display refresh policy (partial + full every N)
nodes.norm_label: display refresh policy (partial + full every n)
nodes.rationale: Full refresh every N partials clears ghosting; limit refresh count due to panel write cycles.

nodes.label: Linear 4-page navigation with fixed 4-slot bottom bar
nodes.norm_label: linear 4-page navigation with fixed 4-slot bottom bar
nodes.rationale: Fixed slots keep touch muscle memory; <- means previous page in linear order; -> on Settings wraps to Home; tap only, no swipes.

nodes.label: Power policy (RTC alarm wake per minute, deep sleep)
nodes.norm_label: power policy (rtc alarm wake per minute, deep sleep)

nodes.label: FreeRTOS task layout (audio/SD on core 1, UI on core 0)
nodes.norm_label: freertos task layout (audio/sd on core 1, ui on core 0)
nodes.rationale: Audio and SD pinned away from UI because e-paper refresh blocks 0.3-2 s.

nodes.label: Crash-safe WAV recording (PCM16 mono 16 kHz, PSRAM ring buffer)
nodes.norm_label: crash-safe wav recording (pcm16 mono 16 khz, psram ring buffer)
nodes.rationale: Stream to SD, never whole in RAM; patch header + fsync every ~2 s so file is playable after power cut; 64 KB ring buffer absorbs SD latency spikes.
